# Optimity Technologies — AI products for calls, leads and business systems

> Optimity Technologies builds AI products that answer calls, follow up leads and work across business systems, and builds custom AI systems when a product doesn't fit. Concierge AI answers calls and books appointments, with editions for movers (Move Concierge AI™), home-service trades (Trade Concierge AI) and nail and hair salons (Salon Concierge AI). Property Connect AI™ calls real-estate web leads back within a minute. Nexus AI™ answers questions across ERP, CRM, databases and documents.

Optimity is a team of senior engineers and architects in India, the USA and the UAE. Its products connect to the systems a business already runs. People stay in charge: the voice products pass complaints, unusual requests and anything they can't answer to staff, and Nexus AI only takes actions that have been approved.

## Products

- [Concierge AI](https://optimitytechnologies.com/concierge-ai.html): an AI receptionist that answers every call, day or night, books appointments into the business's booking system, shows every call and booking in one dashboard, and hands emergencies, complaints and anything it can't answer to a person. It does not quote prices. Connected to the business's phone line and booking system during setup. Editions:
  - [Trade Concierge AI](https://optimitytechnologies.com/trade-concierge.html): the AI receptionist for plumbers and home-service trades (electricians, HVAC techs, handymen). Books jobs into the schedule and passes urgent calls to the person the business chooses.
  - [Salon Concierge AI](https://optimitytechnologies.com/salon-concierge.html): the AI receptionist for nail and hair salons, beauty studios and barbers. Books the right technician or stylist, moves appointments when plans change, and for price questions books a consultation or passes the question to the team.
- [Move Concierge AI™](https://optimitytechnologies.com/move-concierge.html): the movers edition of Concierge AI. Voice AI for moving companies. Answers the inbound and after-hours calls routed to it; asks about the move (date, origin and destination, home size, stairs and elevator access, large or fragile items); writes up a structured lead with recording and transcript; books a virtual or in-home estimate or a callback where configured; sends the caller an SMS or WhatsApp summary; and passes the lead to staff by email or in the moving software or CRM. It does not give binding prices, promise dates or agree to exceptions. Connects to Google Calendar or a dispatch or booking tool, MoveOps, Supermove, HubSpot, a webhook to the company's own database, SMS and WhatsApp Business.
- [Property Connect AI™](https://optimitytechnologies.com/property-connect.html): voice AI for real-estate teams. Calls new web leads back within a minute, answers listing questions, checks budget, pre-approval and timeline, books tours in agents' calendars and warm-transfers serious buyers after a private briefing. CRM sync with Follow Up Boss, kvCORE, HubSpot, Salesforce or custom webhooks.
- [Nexus AI™](https://optimitytechnologies.com/nexus-ai.html): plain-English questions across ERPNext, Odoo, HubSpot, PostgreSQL and documents, with the source of each answer shown. Three engines (SmartOps AI™, DocIntellect AI™, SQL Database Agent). Read-only SQL sandboxes, Clerk-based tenant isolation, private LLM deployment through vLLM, row-level access control; actions only where configured and approved.
- [All products](https://optimitytechnologies.com/products.html): short overview of Concierge AI, Property Connect AI and Nexus AI.

## Custom AI systems

- [Custom AI Systems](https://optimitytechnologies.com/custom-ai-systems.html): focused workflows, agents, integrations and interfaces for operational needs the products don't cover, built around existing systems, preferring reusable components. Delivery: discover the workflow, configure, integrate, launch, improve. Code written only for a client belongs to the client; extensions of an Optimity product stay in the product.
